capabilities: Insert the current date and time using user-defined named formats
Wrap timestamps with prefix, suffix, bold, or code styling
Insert AI conversation stamps with per-prefix formats and separators
Open or create today's daily note and insert under a heading
Trigger insertion via ribbon icon or commands
extras: Includes a 'Support the developer' button and promotes a separate pre-configured product, the AI Work Log Vault, built around this plugin.
intentEvidence: Existing plugins either offer only a single format or focus on lists/frontmatter.
motivation: The author wanted frictionless logging: multiple named formats, clean styling, AI-specific stamps, and a daily-note mode so logging stays frictionless.
problem: Manually typing timestamps breaks flow, and existing timestamp plugins offer only a single format or focus on lists and frontmatter rather than flexible in-note insertion.

relations.evidence: The formatter uses Moment.js when available (most Obsidian installs include it)

summary: Timestamp insertion plugin that inserts the current date and time in multiple named formats, with AI conversation stamps and daily-note awareness.
